intro: Try features that are still being finished, or switch between the stable way of doing something and a new one. If something doesn't work well, come back here and choose the default.
scope_note: Each item here explains where it applies and when it takes effect.
save_failed: Couldn't confirm this was saved in this browser. Check that the browser lets sites store data, then try again.
invalid: A saved choice from another version of Persona isn't recognized, so the default is used. Choosing an option replaces it.
unreadable: This browser isn't letting Persona read its saved settings, so the default is used and a change may not be saved.
terminal_renderer_hint: How the single terminal view is drawn. WebGL uses the graphics card, which can be smoother with lots of output or small text, but doesn't work in every browser. Full view isn't affected.
terminal_renderer_activation: Terminals you open after changing it. A terminal that's already open keeps its renderer, and what you typed in it, until you open it again or reload the page.
terminal_renderer_rollback: Choose Standard. If WebGL stops working in a terminal, that terminal switches back to Standard by itself, and so does this setting.
work_hint: Let your assistant look up the guide and tools it needs for to-dos, delegation and reviews.
work_activation: Start a new chat to apply your choice fully. An open chat may keep its earlier instructions and tool information.
work_rollback: Turn this off and start a new chat to restore the usual instructions and tool loading.
work_saved: Saved. Start a new chat to fully apply this choice.
work_unsupported: Update this assistant to change this setting.
todos_v2_hint: Try the unified experimental To-dos & Tasks workflow as new capabilities roll out behind this switch (tracked in #14538).
todos_v2_activation: Takes effect immediately on the next view or request.
todos_v2_rollback: Turn this off at any time to return to the standard To-dos & Tasks experience with zero data loss.
todos_v2_saved: Saved. Changes take effect immediately on the next view or request.
todos_v2_unsupported: Update this assistant to change this setting.
todos_v2_auto_seen_hint: Automatically clear unread badges for tasks completed autonomously.
todos_v2_pending_review_sla_hint: How long finished tasks stay quiet in Working before escalating to Needs you.
todos_v2_can_wait_sla_hint: How long low-priority decisions wait before escalating to Needs you.
todos_v2_quiet_hours_hint: Hold non-urgent reminders during this 24-hour window (overnight supported). Urgent P0 alerts, approvals, and action cards always bypass quiet hours.
todos_v2_quiet_hours_invalid: Choose a valid 24-hour range (HH:MM–HH:MM) with distinct start and end times.
todos_v2_digest_window_hint: Group non-urgent updates into a single digest over this window instead of pinging one by one.
todos_v2_fold_children_label: Fold non-urgent child tasks under top-level goals
todos_v2_fold_children_hint: Keep routine subtasks tucked under their parent goal unless they need your attention.
integrations_v2_hint: Try the unified experimental Integrations & Extensions experience as new capabilities roll out behind this switch (tracked in #14802).
integrations_v2_activation: Takes effect immediately on the next view or request.
integrations_v2_rollback: Turn this off at any time to restore the standard Connectors, Channels, Inbox Sources, and Extensions views and routing with zero data loss.
integrations_v2_saved: Saved. Changes take effect immediately on the next view or request.
integrations_v2_unsupported: Update this assistant to change this setting.
